description: Send a VOICE note to a contact as a first-class mDM `voice` message (not a URL stub). Pass audio bytes as base64; the tool uploads to Storage and posts via message-send with the voice attachment descriptor. SCAFFOLD: mDM is client-encrypted — until the seal step ships, bytes are uploaded unsealed (TODO Lane A).

audio_base64.description: Attachment bytes as base64 (or a data: URL). MCP is JSON-only, so binary is base64-encoded. Max ~15 MB decoded.

duration_ms.description: Audio clip length in ms (voice only), if known.

mime.description: MIME type, e.g. audio/ogg, application/pdf, image/png.

reply_to_id.description: Optional id of the message being replied to.

thread_label.description: Optional thread label within the conversation (mDM USP: multiple threads per contact).

to.description: Recipient identity id (UUID). Use mDM_list_contacts to find it.

name: mDM_send_voice
